import torch


def reparameterize(mu, logvar, eps):
    mu, logvar, eps = torch.tensor(mu), torch.tensor(logvar), torch.tensor(eps)
    z = mu + torch.exp(0.5 * logvar) * eps
    return [round(v, 3) for v in z.tolist()]
